hero.title: Advocacy
hero.subtitle: We raise awareness on how crucial the marine sector is in shaping policy, advancing the blue economy, and promoting sustainable ocean use in the Gulf of Guinea.

campaigns.title: International Maritime Security Working Group
campaigns.description: The IMSWG forum is a leading platform for regional knowledge sharing and research, with insight into international trends.

campaigns.title: Blue World Initiative
campaigns.description: BWI is an Ocean literacy program for Basic and Second Cycle school students with the knowledge and tools to become informed and engaged ocean stewards.

campaigns.title: Blue Career and Business Expo
campaigns.description: The Blue Career and Business Expo is a yearly programme designed to create dynamic opportunity-exchange platforms that enable young people to engage with maritime industry leaders and actively contribute to building a robust blue economy in Africa.

campaigns.title: Blue World Initiative
campaigns.description: BWI is an Ocean literacy program for Basic and Second Cycle school students with the knowledge and tools to become informed and engaged ocean stewards. Our ocean covers over 70% of our planet and plays an essential role in regulating climate, providing food and resources, and supporting incredible biodiversity.
